summary.text: Wayne Hartman is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 38C who was first elected in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Ocean City town councilman and owner of Wayne Hartman Management, LLC, he serves on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Hartman was born in Baltimore on December 14, 1967, and graduated from Eastern Vocational Technical High School in 1985 and earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Phoenix in 2006, according to his General Assembly biography.
He has owned Wayne Hartman Management, LLC since 2008.

Hartman served on the Worcester County Planning Commission from 2009 to 2014 and on the Ocean City Development Corporation board of directors from 2009 to 2016, and he was a member of the Ocean City Town Council from 2014 to 2018, where he chaired the Recreation and Parks Committee in 2016 to 2018.
Hartman served on the Judiciary Committee in 2019 and 2020 and has been a member of the Ways and Means Committee since 2020.
He has been Chief Deputy Minority Whip since 2023 and has chaired the Worcester County House Delegation since 2019.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
